Latency SLOs: p50 < 80ms, p95 < 180ms, p99 < 400ms for short-turn chats (<=1k tokens).
Throughput targets: steady-state 120 requests/sec across 10 routes; peak bursts up to 400 req/sec for 2-3 minute windows.

cost_model_summary:
Summary of cost model provided to Ironwood (flattened):

- Assumptions:
  * Baseline reserved pool: 4 x A100-80GB equivalent vGPUs (dedicated) with monthly commit.
  * Burst pool: autoscaleable to 8 nodes for short windows (pay-per-use).
  * Avg session token generation: 1,200 tokens per request (median).
  * KV cache hit rate scenarios: 35% (low), 50% (target), 65% (optimistic).
  * Utilization cases modeled: conservative 40%, baseline 60%, aggressive 80%.

- Unit costs used in model (example pricing inputs):
  * Reserved node effective cost: $22,500/node/month (all-in: infra + maintenance + license) => $90,000/month for 4 nodes.
  * Burst vGPU on-demand: $6.00/vGPU-hour.
  * Estimate of token processing capacity: one A100-equivalent node processes ~3.6M tokens/hour at target latency under batching profile used in POC.

- Derived metrics (baseline numbers):
  * Effective provisioned token capacity/month (4 nodes): 3.6M tokens/hr * 24 * 30 * 4 = 10.368B tokens/month.
  * At 60% utilization -> consumed tokens covered by reserved pool = 6.22B tokens/month.
  * Cost per 1K tokens (reserved pool) = $90,000 / (6.22B / 1,000) ≈ $0.0145 per 1K tokens.
  * When adding amortized infra & SRE overhead (20%), unit cost ≈ $0.0174 per 1K tokens.

- Sensitivity: 
  * Conservative (40% util): cost per 1K tokens ≈ $0.0218 (worse by ~25% vs baseline).
  * Aggressive (80% util): cost per 1K tokens ≈ $0.0109 (better unit economics).
  * Cache hit delta: moving from 35% to 65% reduces generated tokens by ~15% effective, improving unit cost by ~15% at same util.

- Commercial levers recommended to improve unit economics:
  1) Commit to minimum 12-month reserved pool to secure 10-15% price concession on node rates.
  2) Implement aggressive KV caching and response truncation on non-critical routes to raise effective cache hit to 50%+.
  3) Use quantized model variants for high-throughput non-critical routes (expected 1.4x token throughput per vGPU).
  4) Define clear burst pricing and pre-approved burst budget to avoid over-spend during marketing spikes.

- Break-even analysis provided: at current traffic forecast (median scenario), break-even vs public hosted API occurs ~8-10 months after commit (with 12-month minimum and 60% util).

- Negotiation items highlighted for AE/Finance: commit length vs price, attrition credit for unused reserved capacity, SLA credit tiers for p95/p99 misses, and reimbursement calculation for unplanned burst hours.
